name: eallion.com
description: eallion.com hugo blog theme by pehtheme

scripts.build: run-s clean directus build:css gen:llms build:hugo build:pagefind
scripts.build:chroma: \rm -f ../assets/css/chroma.css && hugo gen chromastyles --style=github | sed 's/\./html:not(.dark) ./' >> ../assets/css/chroma.css && hugo gen chromastyles --style=github-dark | sed 's/\./html.dark ./' >> ../assets/css/chroma.css
scripts.dev:hugo: open-cli http://127.0.0.1:1313 && hugo server -w -D -p 1313 --bind 0.0.0.0 --contentDir content -e production --gc --minify --disableKinds RSS --disableFastRender --renderToMemory --printUnusedTemplates --templateMetrics --templateMetricsHints
scripts.dev:pagefind: pnpm build:css && pnpm build:hugo && pagefind --site public --output-subdir pagefind --force-language zh && open-cli http://127.0.0.1:1414 && npx serve public -l 1414

author: Charles Chin
